snippet.title: Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond PV Debut
snippet.description:
The Chinese horror puzzle game-Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond PV Debut. Dual-platform pre-order on Steam and Mobile is now open!

This time, we temporarily leave the familiar Zangling Village and journey to the scenically stunning Liangjian Kou Resort to experience its unique customs.

In addition to the new protagonist and new setting, Paper Bride 7 will also feature two familiar friends from Paper Bride 3. How will their stories continue to unfold?

In this Liangjian Kou, your fate is sealed at birth, no words need be spoken.
Under the Gold-Silver Bridge, Do Not Betray Somebody’s Longing.

----Pre-Order---
Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3627790/7/
Google：https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.funnygames.escape.zjy7hw
App Store(iOS)：https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751835092
